primary_behaviors: Server-derived principal/workspace/session/runtime generation/UI/revision/process/run constraints are checked through native grant, immutable bundle and exact receipt owners. Identity drift, revoked grants, foreign/ambiguous run selectors and corrupted bytes deny reads or mutations.

Preview grants contain only process.read/results/navigate. Every mutation is rejected before the native owner; invokeTool, authoring and native-token substitution do not provide presentation authority. Streams revalidate current grants per chunk. Existing provider/MCP declarations cannot adopt the reserved process bridge.

The generated process UI calls the existing native owners; process, review/action and uncertainty authority remain unchanged. Static CSP and isolated local runtime complement the closed client and source checks; those checks alone are not the enforcement boundary.

The additive BaseAgentEngine context pins process-ui-author/1, immutable versioned instructions, inherited default model and an empty executable-tool scope. Unqualified adapters and model/configuration drift fail before broad chat/workspace activation; ordinary chat remains unchanged.

Hermes model-only SDK calls preserve prepared system instructions on every turn, tools=[]/tool_choice=none and resolver identities. Tool requests, absent or changed attestations and unsupported overrides cannot silently activate tools or change global configuration.

Both actual engineering interfaces have generation and focused-update revisions recording Hermes, the then-configured gpt-5.6-sol default, instruction/configuration/build hashes and empty authoring capabilities. These are historical actual-model proofs, not fresh inference or qualification of future platforms.

Fixed source/asset envelopes exclude backend/package/build scripts, arbitrary launch/environment and private/dynamic/network imports. The actual fixed compiler checks bindings, schemas and pinned package versions, builds the public reference and rejects invalid source. Installed geometry aliases are trusted toolchain dependencies; direct generated three imports remain forbidden.

Current primary boundary checks accept exactly 1 MiB text, 10 MiB raster/aggregate assets and 32 source+asset files, then reject the next byte/file. Timeout, oversized child output and cancellation dispose only the owned compiler child. Source/build diagnostics remain bounded and redact private locations.

Durable authoring requests and attempts retain role/provenance/trace. At most two diagnostic repairs reuse exact instructions/default model. Exhaustion, cancellation or interrupted owner state is recorded without automatic generation replay.

Vault source/manifest/build/dist inventories are immutable and hash-verified. Save requires the exact observed preview and current source/hash CAS; corruption/overwrite and unsaved working mode are denied. Revised source preserves parent provenance and compatible rollback uses existing revision selection.

The current installed wheel contains byte-identical public client/kit sources/styles/manifests, authoring instructions/schema/template/fixed builder and generic static runtime. Distribution tests independently rebuild root/service wheels and service sdist, then compile shipped reference/result-reader sources with an explicitly qualified native dependency root.

Installed static HTTP serves only verified dist and health with restrictive headers, rejects alternate/private paths and changed launch/authority during relocation, and needs no compiler/model subprocess. Discovery does not guess an ancestor checkout or borrow missing public sources.

Current detached native browser proofs open exact saved/common interfaces with unavailable compiler/model and no checkout imports, generation, download, compilation or engineering mutation. Earlier clean Docker proofs retain their original wheel and host scope; they are not relabelled as the current wheel.
